verdict.rationale: SerpApi returns structured JSON search results, including organic and news results, across many engines. Its Events API explicitly lists titles, dates and links, and Brave AI Mode returns references. However, the pack never documents title, link or published-date fields for organic or news results, and never mentions canonical URL handling. missing for 10: documented title/link/date fields on organic and news results, canonical-URL normalization, independent or hands-on confirmation of citation-ready metadata.
